# dr_libs decoder snapshot

`dr_mp3.h` is pinned from `mackron/dr_libs` commit
`b55a0d9a30b91ad8901f89ecf05f76a33186c185` (2026-08-19).

- Upstream: https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs
- Header blob: `01a0f6e1538b667e4e44a6a8eb7363a7f32095b1`
- Header SHA-256: `75fb7da86797f40b0534e0a09894f8189540ce61360ea6ffcb9b888d4889a256`
- License choice used by this project: MIT No Attribution (MIT-0)

The decoder is used by the Vita SDL_sound compatibility layer to stream the
original RPG Maker MP3 assets through `SDL_RWops`. Game files remain unchanged.
